title: dev.agentpod.turn.v1
description: What an agent did during one turn: the durable record, one room event per turn that used a tool, sent before the answer. `tools` is capped at 20 (the hub's TURN_TOOLS_MAX) in the order the calls were first made; `counts` describes the whole turn regardless, so a capped list is never mistaken for a complete one. An empty `tools` is valid. Mirrors AgentPod's `TurnActivity` and the hub's `turnActivityContent` (`apps/hub/src/services/matrix-as/activity.ts`). Readers ignore properties they do not know.

schema_version.description: The content's minor version. AgentPod sends 1. Additive changes raise it; a reader draws a higher version best-effort, never drops it.

session_id.description: A turn-scoped id: a new value starts a new turn. The AgentPod hub sends the ACP session id of the turn it is streaming; the Hermes plugin sends the turn's own id (falling back to Hermes's session id), so a straggler from an earlier turn is never mistaken for this one.

tools.description: The turn's tool calls, the first 20 by first use.

id.description: The call's id, as its tool updates carried it.

title.description: What the call did, as display text. The hub falls back to the id rather than send a nameless row.

kind.description: ACP's tool kind (read, edit, execute, ...), passed through from the harness unvalidated. Opaque display text: never switched on. Absent when the harness did not say; never sent empty.

status.description: ACP's tool lifecycle. The hub sends one of pending, in_progress, completed, failed; the Hermes plugin never sends pending (a call starts at in_progress). Open to readers: a value not listed in x-treaty-known-values is valid and is drawn generically, never dropped.

counts.description: The whole turn, not just the listed tools.

total.description: Every tool call the turn made.

omitted.description: How many are not in `tools` because of the cap.
